''See also: [[Wandering Titan Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Wandering [[Titan]] is a [[Dreadgod]], a colossal and terrifying force of nature characterized by its inevitability rather than its speed. Described as a turtle-shelled armored warrior, the entity possesses a massive black shell that can resemble an island or a hill and features human-like, five-fingered hands. It is a creature of immense [[scale]], with fingers as large as towers and eyes that loom above the clouds. The [[Titan]] is known to feed on powerful materials, such as minerals, [[aura]], and fragments of destroyed worlds, which contributes to its growing strength over centuries. In combat, the Wandering [[Titan]] is a devastating force capable of upending the heavens and earth, straining the fabric of space with its movements. It has been observed engaging in massive battles against [[Monarchs]] and other [[Dreadgods]], demonstrating unexpected intelligence through tactics like switching places with its own kind or using portals. While it is often viewed as an unstoppable disaster that can bury entire populations simply by walking, it has also been shown to be vulnerable to intense combat or suppression. The entity's presence is so overwhelming that it causes the earth to shake for miles and can cause spiritual senses to tremble. Various groups, such as the [[Abyssal Palace]], model their paths and imagery after this creature, viewing it as a symbol of near-indestructible power.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|This massive entity is a humanoid [[giant]] of dark, rocky skin that resembles a turtle-shelled armored warrior. It possesses a single colossal eye, a serpentine tail used for balance, and a shell that can rise from the [[water]] like a hill. The creature is also described as a towering black statue with [[stone]]-like features.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Wandering [[Titan]] has been attacked by twelve [[Monarchs]] and fought against them during the [[Dread War]]. [[Brother Aekin]] took on its aspect, while [[Lindon]] has faced it as a challenge and consumed energy from the entity. [[Yerin]] wants [[Northstrider]] to keep the creature away, and [[Northstrider]] has been seen in battle with it. The [[Titan]] also clashed with the [[Ghost]], swapped places with the [[Silent King]], and shattered the [[bloodline armor]] of [[Mercy]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Wandering [[Titan]] utilizes a [[hunger techniques|hunger technique]] to consume physical materials and powerful minerals, driven by a returning [[hunger]]. Its combat repertoire includes the use of a [[Striker technique]], punches that provide momentum, and the ability to breathe gold [[black dragon's breath|dragon's breath]]. Additionally, it can blink through space, break portals, and cause earthquakes.}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|The awakening stirs}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|The awakening of the Wandering [[Titan]] is a significant upcoming event that is expected to occur in less than three months, amid growing buzz regarding its stirring.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c2">''Wintersteel'', chapter 2</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c3">''Wintersteel'', chapter 3</ref> This [[Dreadgod]] is a location that has moved to the edge of [[Akura clan territory|Akura territory]] and currently serves as the site for an [[Akura clan|Akura]] operation.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c5">''Wintersteel'', chapter 5</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c7">''Wintersteel'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c9">''Wintersteel'', chapter 9</ref> Often depicted as a man-walking turtle, the creature's shell has become a hill rising from the [[water]] while one arm has reached up to the land.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c9" /> The Wandering [[Titan]] feeds on minerals and powerful materials, and because it is a being from which [[madra]] can be drained, people must be evacuated before its eventual awakening.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c9" /><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c12">''Wintersteel'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c23">''Wintersteel'', chapter 23</ref> As the [[Dreadgod]] wakes early, survivors may face dangers from [[Dreadgod cults]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c13">''Wintersteel'', chapter 13</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c28">''Wintersteel'', chapter 28</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|Approaching the land}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|The Wandering [[Titan]] is an inevitable threat that [[cloudship]] crews are ordered to flee from.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c2">''Bloodline'', chapter 2</ref><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c4">''Bloodline'', chapter 4</ref> This humanoid [[giant]] of dark [[stone]] kneels at the ocean's edge, featuring a [[monkey]]-like tail and a turtle's shell rising behind its shoulders.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c4" /> Its presence dominates the [[earth aura]] for hundreds of miles as it uses a [[hunger techniques|hunger technique]] to consume physical materials and power.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c4" /> Depicted as one of the four [[Dreadgods]] in a [[mural]], the entity cycled its [[madra]] for a brief instant.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c4" /><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c6">''Bloodline'', chapter 6</ref> As the titan approaches with power waxing like a rising sun, it is expected to arrive in one week.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c10">''Bloodline'', chapter 10</ref><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c12">''Bloodline'', chapter 12</ref> The massive entity crashed through a mountain and let out a roar after being struck by an arrow.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c13">''Bloodline'', chapter 13</ref><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c15">''Bloodline'', chapter 15</ref> The titan's rocky skin and ability to break portals allow it to cut a swath of devastation across the landscape.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c16">''Bloodline'', chapter 16</ref><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c17">''Bloodline'', chapter 17</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|Battle at Sacred Valley}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|After turning back toward [[Sacred Valley]], the Wandering [[Titan]] eventually arrived at the location.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c17" /><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c18">''Bloodline'', chapter 18</ref> This entity represents a challenge for [[Lindon]] and acts as a force of nature similar to an [[aura-storm]] or a thunderbolt.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c18" /> As [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]]'s group engaged in combat with the creature, it began to draw its hand back for a swipe while its foot appeared to cover the sky from [[Yerin]]'s perspective.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c19">''Bloodline'', chapter 19</ref> The [[Titan]] had been searching for the source of [[hunger madra]], and its presence caused [[Lindon]] to experience appetites that made him long to consume a mummified hand.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c22">''Bloodline'', chapter 22</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Journey to Moongrave}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|The Wandering [[Titan]] attempted to cross a [[portal]] in an effort to attack [[Moongrave]], and it is currently on its way to the location.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c8">''Dreadgod'', chapter 8</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c12">''Dreadgod'', chapter 12</ref> As everyone prepares to face the entity, it serves as a reference for strength.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c12" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c13">''Dreadgod'', chapter 13</ref> This [[Dreadgod]] is a towering black statue with [[stone]]-like skin and shell, featuring a serpentine tail.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c15">''Dreadgod'', chapter 15</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c21">''Dreadgod'', chapter 21</ref> While it cannot attack minds, the creature is capable of breathing gold [[black dragon's breath|dragon's breath]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c15" /> [[Blackflame City]] was evacuated before the Wandering [[Titan]] arrived.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c21" />}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Mercy]] possesses prior experience in confronting a weakened Wandering [[Titan]], an entity that [[Lindon]] associates with a specific symbol found on one of the [[The Paths of Heaven|Paths of Heaven]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c3">''Waybound'', chapter 3</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c4">''Waybound'', chapter 4</ref> This creature is an echo of [[hunger madra]] that has the ability to blink through space, and its vitality and [[blood essence]] were once consumed by [[Lindon]]'s [[Dreadgod's hand|Dreadgod hand]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c11">''Waybound'', chapter 11</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c14">''Waybound'', chapter 14</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c15">''Waybound'', chapter 15</ref> The Wandering [[Titan]] once swapped places with the [[Silent King]] and can even be fashioned into a hammer.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c21">''Waybound'', chapter 21</ref> Characterized by a single colossal eye, the entity uses its tail to maintain balance and employs a [[Striker technique]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c24">''Waybound'', chapter 24</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c27">''Waybound'', chapter 27</ref> During combat, the [[Titan]] can utilize a punch to provide momentum and has even cracked its tail into [[Lindon]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c28">''Waybound'', chapter 28</ref>}}
